Tailor It uses the camera so the apps you make can take and record photos and videos, scan QR codes, and record video while the dashcam screen is shown.
Tailor It uses Health Connect data so the apps you make can show steps and weight, and save the weight you record.
Tailor It uses your location so the apps you make can record it, show it on a map, guide you to a destination, and notify you when you arrive near a saved place (arrival is checked on this device).
Tailor It uses the microphone to make apps from what you say, and so the apps you make can turn your speech into text on this device and record audio.

Tailor It connects to nearby devices to find other Tailor It devices around you, so you can send and receive records and song requests on the spot, or exchange them in passing. On Android 12 and 12L, it also asks for location access to find nearby devices (your location is not recorded or sent).
Tailor It uses notifications so the apps you make can remind you at the times and places you set.
